battle.name: 建州之戰
battle.brief: 建炎四年七月，私鹽販范汝為聚眾十餘萬據福建建州起義，光澤、順昌饑民響應；十月辛企宗率一萬兵至邵武敗績，朝廷改命韓世忠率三萬眾入閩。紹興二年正月官軍連攻建州，數月而城陷，范汝為退至回源洞自焚。配重投石車即越牆拋石、毀壞城堞的一環，與雲梯同時壓上，替步卒開路。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 建州之戰是南宋建炎四年（一一三〇）到紹興二年（一一三二）之間，朝廷軍隊在福建建州（治建安縣，今福建建甌市）圍攻范汝為起義軍的作戰。交戰一方是南宋朝廷在福建的軍政體系：福建路安撫使司掌一路民政軍政，提點刑獄司與轉運司分掌刑獄與財賦，兵馬都監與各軍都統制掌兵柄，鎮江方向的行營與江淮軍司亦可調兵增援；建炎四年十月朝廷加派神武副軍都統制辛企宗，年底改命韓世忠以福建、江西、荊湖宣撫副使的名義總領三路討賊。另一方是起義軍：領袖范汝為本是私鹽販子，因官府禁止販私、欠債與饑荒聚眾，於建炎四年七月據建州城起事，旬日之間從者十餘萬，光澤、順昌一帶饑民同時響應，與建州互為犄角。起義軍並非正規編制，而以市井私鹽集團為核心，吸納散兵游勇、逃卒與無籍饑民，憑城垣、竹木與鄉里熟悉地形之利拒官軍。宋廷圍剿大軍屢次入閩，兵禍相連，官軍自身又缺餉欠糧，兩造都在消耗中掙扎。起義軍最終被鎮壓，但另一支受其影響而起的起義在龍泉、處州一帶轉戰後亦被平定。
countriesEn: The Battle of Jianzhou was fought from the fourth year of Jianyan (1130) to the second year of Shaoxing (1132), when a government army besieged the rebel host of Fan Ruwei at Jianzhou in Fujian, the seat of Jian'an county and present-day Jian'ou. One side was the military and administrative apparatus of the Southern Song in Fujian: the Circuit Pacification Commission (Anfusi) handled civil and military government, the Judicial Review Commission (Tiandingsi) and the Transport Commission (Zhuan yunsi) divided criminal justice and finance between them, while the Regional Military Commissioner and the commanders of the various armies held the troops; field camps on the Zhenjiang front and the Jianghuai Military Commission could also send reinforcements. In the tenth month of Jianyan the court added the Shenwu Deputy Army Commander Xin Qizong, and by the end of the year appointed Han Shizhong Pacification Deputy Commissioner for Fujian, Jiangxi and Jinghu, giving him overall charge of the suppression across three circuits. The other side was the insurgents. Their leader, Fan Ruwei, had been a private salt smuggler: with the government ban on salt dealing, his debts and the famine pushing him into outlawry, he rose at Jianzhou in the seventh month of 1130, and within ten days more than a hundred thousand men gathered to him, while hungry people at Guangze and Shunchang answered the rising and formed a second front to the city. The rebel force was not a regular formation. At its core stood the urban guild of salt smugglers, swollen by deserters, loose soldiers and unregistered famine victims, and it held the city on the strength of the walls, of timber works and of its familiarity with the local terrain. Court columns had marched into Fujian again and again, and the endless war had drained a government army that was itself short of pay and of grain, so that both sides were struggling under attrition. The rising was crushed in the end, and a related revolt that carried the fight on to Longquan and Chuzhou was put down as well.
people: 此役的關鍵人物有數位。南宋方面，韓世忠（字良臣，綏州人）是本役的主帥：早年出身行伍，嘗為抗金的義軍首領，後受招安為將，鎮江之役與梁紅玉力拒金兀朮南侵而名震天下；建炎四年被任為福建、江西、荊湖宣撫副使，率兵三萬入閩，他是唯一真正打到建州城下並迫使城破的人。辛企宗是神武副軍都統制，紹興初年以敢戰著稱，一一三〇年十月奉調率兵一萬討伐范汝為，軍至邵武一戰而敗，遂不敢前進。福建安撫使程邁在同年八月率先率軍攻討失利，後改用誘降之策，派謝向、陸棠等人混入義軍招安；范汝為一度就招而旋復叛，說明單靠招撫無法解決問題。起義方面，范汝為是私鹽販出身的首領，據城數月，最後退至回源洞自焚而死；其部眾則由光澤、順昌方向的饑民響應者接續抵抗，轉戰龍泉、處州。地方上，福建一路自葉濃軍亂、苗劉兵變以來飽受兵禍，將士與官吏的所為及其應對失當，才是使一名私鹽販能聚起十餘萬眾的直接背景。
peopleEn: Several figures shaped this campaign. On the Song side, Han Shizhong, courtesy name Liangchen, a native of Suizhou, was the commander of the operation. He began as a rank-and-file soldier, once led an armed band loyal to the anti-Jin cause, and was later enrolled into the Southern Song as a general; his stand at Zhenjiang with his wife Liang Hongyu against the southward drive of Jin Wanyan Zongbi had already made his name. In Jianyan 4 he was appointed Pacification Deputy Commissioner for Fujian, Jiangxi and Jinghu and brought thirty thousand men into Fujian; he was the only man who actually reached the walls of Jianzhou and forced the city to fall. Xin Qizong, commander of the deputy Shenwu army, was known for his daring in the early Shaoxing years; in the tenth month of 1130 he was sent with ten thousand men against Fan Ruwei, was beaten at Shaowu, and did not dare advance any further. Cheng Mai, the Circuit Pacification Commissioner of Fujian, led the first attack in the eighth month of the same year and was repulsed, after which he switched to a policy of deception and sent men such as Xie Xiang and Lu Tang into the rebel ranks to offer terms; Fan Ruwei submitted for a time and then rebelled again, showing that appeasement alone could not settle the matter. On the rebel side, Fan Ruwei, a salt smuggler who had become a commander, held the city for several months and finally burned himself to death in the Huiyuan cave; the remainder of the movement was carried on by the famine victims who had risen at Guangze and Shunchang and was chased through Longquan and Chuzhou. In the country itself, Fujian had suffered from one war after another since the Ye Nong mutiny and the Miao-Liu mutiny, and the conduct of its soldiers and officials, together with their misjudged responses, was the immediate background that allowed a salt smuggler to gather more than a hundred thousand followers.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車（Trebuchet，一一〇〇年，意大利）在建州之役中的位置，是攻城序列裡負責越牆毀壞城堞、壓制守軍的長臂投石器械。歐洲自十一世紀起即以配重式投石車為攻城主力，射程可越過城牆，擊毀城樓、堡壘與密集的守禦序列；同一時期中國的攻城體系則以砲（石砲、砲車）為主，輔以天橋、對樓、雲梯、火砲等器械。紹興二年正月韓世忠督軍進攻建州，所用正是天橋、對樓、雲梯、火砲齊施的攻城辦法：雲梯供兵登牆，天橋與對樓遮蔽進攻部隊並在牆頭交鋒，火砲（宋軍常用的霹靂砲一類火藥武器）用於破壞城門與城堞，而砲車與投石機負責把石彈拋進城內，摧毀房屋、牆段，逼守軍暴露在梯隊之下。起義軍一方則大量使用民間可得之物：埋於延平至建州驛道兩側的巨木鹿角、密布的竹簽、鐵蒺藜與陷馬坑，用以遲滯官軍；焚燒橋樑、堆塞道路以割斷宋軍的推進；守城時倚靠城垣、房屋與臨時築起的木柵。韓世忠自溫州、台州一路靠海船運兵，海上轉輸與陸上投石器械相互配合，構成此役器械運用的一個特色。
kitsEn: The card's counterweight trebuchet, dated to 1100 and assigned to Italy, sits in this battle in the place of the long-armed stone-throwing engine that breaks the parapet over the wall and pins down the defenders. In Europe from the eleventh century the counterweight trebuchet was the main siege engine, its range carrying stones across the curtain to smash towers, bastions and densely packed defensive positions; the Chinese siege system of the same period relied on stone-throwing engines and bombards, supported by gangplanks, fighting towers, scaling ladders and gunpowder weapons. In the first month of Shaoxing 2, when Han Shizhong pressed the attack against Jianzhou, he used precisely such a combined method: scaling ladders for the assault on the wall, gangplanks and fighting towers to cover the attackers and to fight along the parapet, and gunpowder bombs to break the gates and the merlons, while the bombards and stone-throwing engines lobbed stones into the town to destroy houses and stretches of wall and force the defenders out into the open below the ladders. The insurgents worked with what the countryside could give them: enormous timber cheval-de-frise planted along the post road between Yanping and Jianzhou, dense bamboo splinters and iron caltrops, and pits dug for horses, all of which slowed the government troops; they burned the bridges and blocked the roads to sever the Song advance; and in the defence they relied on the city wall, on the houses and on timber palisades thrown up in haste. Han Shizhong's men were moved by sea from Wenzhou and Taizhou, and the combination of maritime transport with land-based throwing engines is one of the distinctive features of the equipment employed in this campaign.
tactics: 起義爆發後，宋廷的戰術經歷數次反覆。八月程邁部正面攻城失利，轉為誘降；十月辛企宗率一萬兵直取建州，至邵武敗績後不敢再進。真正改變戰局的是韓世忠，他不急於強攻：紹興元年（一一三一）十一月，韓世忠先派精兵自溫州、台州登船，沿海路北上，水陸並進，經福唐（今福清）溯閩江抵延平（今南平）。義軍沿途焚橋、塞路，在延平至建州之間的狹窄驛道上埋巨木為鹿角，廣布竹簽、鐵蒺藜，挖設陷馬坑，把官軍的推進速度壓到最低。韓世忠受阻改道，遣先鋒乘馬浮渡劍潭，偃旗息鼓沿山斬荊棘，間道潛行至鳳凰山（今建甌東北），由山後迂回包圍建州，切斷義軍北面的退路；同時以海路封鎖閩江口，防止首領乘船北走。合圍之後，圍城歷時數月，紹興二年正月官軍以天橋、對樓、雲梯、火砲同時猛攻，日久城破，義軍依托的城垣逐段崩潰，餘眾退保城內巷戰，戰至最後。
tacticsEn: After the rising broke out, the court's approach went through several reversals. In the eighth month Cheng Mai attacked the city frontally, was repulsed, and turned to deception; in the tenth month Xin Qizong marched straight on Jianzhou with ten thousand men, was beaten at Shaowu, and stopped dead. The man who actually changed the course of the war was Han Shizhong, who was in no hurry to force an assault. In the eleventh month of Shaoxing 1 he first put picked troops aboard ships at Wenzhou and Taizhou, moved north along the coast with the sea and the land columns in step, and came up the Min River through Futang (present-day Fuqing) to Yanping (present-day Nanping). The insurgents burned bridges and blocked the roads along the way, and on the narrow post road between Yanping and Jianzhou they planted enormous timbers as chevaux-de-frise, scattered bamboo splinters and iron caltrops, and dug horse-pits, pressing the speed of the government advance to its lowest point. Blocked, Han Shizhong changed his route: he sent the vanguard across the Jantan on horseback, then with flags furled and drums silent had them cut a path through the brush along the hillside and slip by secret paths to the Fenghuang hill north-east of Jian'ou, outflanking the city from the rear and cutting the insurgents' northern line of retreat; at the same time he sealed the mouth of the Min River by sea so that the leader could not escape northward by boat. Once the investment was complete the siege dragged on for months, and in the first month of Shaoxing 2 the government troops attacked in force with gangplanks, fighting towers, scaling ladders and gunpowder bombs all at once. The walls on which the insurgents depended crumbled section by section, the survivors fell back to street fighting inside the town, and the battle was fought out to the end.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但戰役規模可從幾處推知。起義方：一一三〇年七月起事，旬日之間聚眾「十餘萬」，光澤、順昌的饑民響應後，合流者號稱逾十萬，此為史籍所載的概數，實際在城能戰者顯然遠少於此。宋軍方面：辛企宗部一萬，韓世忠入閩之兵三萬，兵力量級約為起義眾的三分之一，且分散在閩浙多地，能投入攻城者有限。時間軸：起義自一一三〇年七月起，至一一三二年正月城陷，前後約十八個月；其中韓世忠自一一三一十一月抵延平，至一一三二年正月城破，圍城與攻擊約兩個月。戰果：城陷時「戰死萬餘人」，被俘殺者五百餘人，范汝為自焚，斬首數無載。距離：溫州沿海至福清約五百餘公里，福清溯閩江抵延平約二百公里，延平至建州建甌約一百二十公里，全線逾千里，糧械須靠海船轉運。補給：遠程作戰的糧秣自溫州、台州海運至福唐，再由閩江內河轉輸至延平、建州，途中尚有叛軍破壞橋樑的牽制。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are few, but the scale of the campaign can be inferred from several of them. On the rebel side: the rising began in the seventh month of 1130 and within ten days more than a hundred thousand men were said to have gathered; after the hungry of Guangze and Shunchang answered it, the combined host was claimed to exceed a hundred thousand, which is the round figure given in the annalistic sources, and the number who could actually fight inside the city was plainly much smaller. On the government side: Xin Qizong had ten thousand men and Han Shizhong brought thirty thousand into Fujian, an order of magnitude about one third of the rebel host, and they were spread over many places in Fujian and Zhejiang, so the force available for the siege was limited. The timeline: the rising ran from the seventh month of 1130 to the fall of the city in the first month of 1132, roughly eighteen months; Han Shizhong reached Yanping in the eleventh month of 1131 and the city fell in the first month of 1132, so the investment and the final assault together lasted about two months. The result at the storming: more than ten thousand killed in action and over five hundred prisoners killed after capture, while Fan Ruwei burned himself to death; no count of heads taken is recorded. Distances: some five hundred kilometres by sea from Wenzhou to Fuqing, some two hundred kilometres up the Min River from Fuqing to Yanping, and some hundred and twenty kilometres from Yanping to Jianzhou at Jian'ou, a line of more than a thousand kilometres that had to be supplied by ship. Supply: grain and materiel for a far-flung operation were carried by sea from Wenzhou and Taizhou to Futang, then transferred to inland river boats for Yanping and Jianzhou, with the insurgents breaking bridges along the way to hold the line.
cause: 建州之戰的起因，須從南宋初年福建一連串的失衡說起。建炎元年九月，建州禁軍軍校張員等六人因轉運司長期拖欠「卸甲錢」而發動兵變，殺傷官員、佔據州城；此後建州葉濃軍亂、苗劉兵變叛軍入閩，接連的圍剿大軍不斷經過福建，一次次向地方索取糧秣與舟船，把戰禍轉嫁給民間。到建炎四年，福建連年兵禍已使田野荒廢、糧食絕乏，饑荒蔓延至光澤、順昌一帶；同時私鹽販因為官府嚴禁私販、販運之路斷絕，生計無著，怨氣集中在范汝為這類私鹽集團首領身上。七月，范汝為率眾據建州起事，所打的旗號正是反抗官府壓迫，饑民大批響應使其在旬月之間膨脹成十餘萬眾的大起義。此役並非孤立的民變：建州之亂的前身是欠餉引發的兵變，是苗劉兵變之後南方秩序崩解的餘波，而朝廷的處置又以誘降、步步進逼為主，反覆失信於義軍，才使原本可以速決的危機拖成十八個月的持久戰。
causeEn: The origins of the Battle of Jianzhou have to be traced back to a whole sequence of failures in early Southern Song Fujian. In the ninth month of Jianyan 1, Zhang Yuan and five other junior officers of the Jianzhou garrison mutinied because the Transport Commission had long withheld the 'armour money' owed to the troops; they killed officials and seized the prefectural seat. After that came the Ye Nong mutiny at Jianzhou and the mutinous troops of the Miao-Liu rebellion entering Fujian, and the columns sent to suppress them marched through the province again and again, taking grain, boats and supplies from the countryside and passing the cost of the wars on to the people. By Jianyan 4 the repeated fighting had left the fields of Fujian abandoned and the grain exhausted, and famine had spread as far as Guangze and Shunchang; at the same time private salt dealers, whose trade had been shut down by the official monopoly and whose routes were cut, had no way to live, and the resentment concentrated on men such as Fan Ruwei, the head of one of the salt guilds. In the seventh month Fan Ruwei rose at Jianzhou with his followers, and the banner they fought under was resistance to official oppression; the mass response of the hungry swelled the rising to more than a hundred thousand within a matter of weeks. The campaign was not an isolated peasant disturbance: it grew out of a mutiny caused by unpaid wages, out of the collapse of southern order after the Miao-Liu rebellion, and the court's handling of it, based on deception and on inching pressure, repeatedly broke its word to the insurgents, and it was that which turned an affair that could have been settled quickly into a war of eighteen months.
impact: 此役的直接後果是福建地方秩序在亂後重建：建州城破之後，義軍餘眾轉戰龍泉、處州（治麗水）一帶，仍以游鬥形式抵抗，隨後被官軍分路鎮壓，起義至此完全失敗。對宋廷而言，此役證明紹興初年的地方軍政已經失序——欠餉、欠糧誘發兵變，圍剿大軍反覆入閩而無長期作戰能力，安撫使只能靠誘降，朝廷最後仍須倚重一位在外素負抗金名聲的宣撫副使才能平事，這一點在後續的軍政整頓與地方安撫政策中不斷被提及。對韓世忠而言，建州之捷補上了他鎮江抗金之外的另一份戰功，也為其後升遷、封鄒國公、諡忠武的仕途添磚；對福建百姓而言，兩年多的戰禍與之後的搜捕、鎮壓，使閩北山區的社會元氣大傷，戶口銳減而山田荒蕪，軍中欠餉的問題亦未因此解決，反而更形尖銳。制度層面上，這場戰爭顯示南宋初期軍隊的糧秣、紀律與地方治理同屬一體的問題：只靠增兵平叛，解決不了欠餉與饑荒帶來的源頭。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the campaign was the re-establishment of order in Fujian after the disorder. Once Jianzhou fell, the remnants of the rebel force carried the struggle on to Longquan and to Chuzhou, seat of Lishui, still resisting as roving bands, and were then broken up by government columns operating on several lines; with that the rising was completely extinguished. For the court the campaign demonstrated that local military and civil government in early Shaoxing had lost its order: unpaid wages and missing grain provoked mutinies, the columns sent to suppress revolts marched repeatedly into Fujian without any capacity for a sustained operation, the pacification commissioner could do nothing but offer deceptive terms, and in the end the court still had to rely on a pacification deputy commissioner with a reputation for fighting the Jin abroad before the affair could be settled; this was repeatedly raised in later reform of the military administration and in relief policy for the region. For Han Shizhong, victory at Jianzhou added to the renown he had won at Zhenjiang and added a stone to the career that would carry him to high office, the title of Duke of Zou and the posthumous name Zhongwu. For the people of Fujian, more than two years of war followed by pursuit and liquidation drained the north Fujian hills, cutting the population and leaving the fields to weeds, and the problem of unpaid soldiers was not solved by the victory but made sharper. At the level of institutions, the war showed that supply, discipline and local government in the early Southern Song were a single problem: adding troops to put down rebellions could never cure the source, which lay in unpaid wages and famine.
result: 紹興二年正月，韓世忠所部以天橋、對樓、雲梯、火砲連日猛攻建州，義軍固守城垣數月，城終於陷落。戰死者萬餘人，被俘殺者五百餘人，首領范汝為退至城外回源洞自焚而死，餘眾或死或散。義軍殘部在龍泉、處州方向轉戰，又被官軍追剿平定，這場自建炎四年七月起、延續至紹興二年、前後約十八個月的起義以失敗告終。對宋廷而言，此役平定了福建境內最後一支成規模的反抗力量，使東南沿海重新回到朝廷控制之下；對韓世忠而言，他以三萬眾、三州之地完成了兩個月的圍城戰，被視為其早年水軍與山林作戰經驗的一次完整運用；對起義者而言，他們在據城固守與沿途遲滯上並非沒有可觀之處，一度逼得官軍迂回、包抄才攻得下城，但終究無法扭轉缺乏外援、糧秣與號召力的處境。史家評此役，多認為它並非一場雙方實力相當的會戰，而是一次以國家軍隊壓制地方亂兵的鎮壓作戰，其勝負早在起義以私鹽集團為核心、捲入大批饑民的那一刻便已決定。
resultEn: In the first month of Shaoxing 2 the troops of Han Shizhong pressed the attack against Jianzhou day after day with gangplanks, fighting towers, scaling ladders and gunpowder bombs; the insurgents held the walls for months and the city at last fell. More than ten thousand were killed in the fighting and over five hundred prisoners were killed after capture; the leader Fan Ruwei burned himself to death in the Huiyuan cave outside the town, and the survivors were killed or scattered. The remnants fought on toward Longquan and Chuzhou and were hunted down and suppressed, and the rising that had begun in the seventh month of Jianyan 4 and run through to Shaoxing 2, some eighteen months in all, ended in defeat. For the court the campaign destroyed the last organised resistance in Fujian and returned the south-eastern coast to government control. For Han Shizhong it was a siege of two months carried out with thirty thousand men drawn from three circuits, and it is read as a complete application of the river and hill fighting he had learned earlier in his career. For the insurgents, their defence of the city and their delaying actions on the road were not without merit, and at one point they forced the government army to outflank and encircle before the walls could be attacked, but in the end nothing could offset their lack of outside aid, of supply and of any wider appeal. In the judgement of historians this was not a meeting of evenly matched armies but an operation of state troops against local insurgents, and its outcome was settled from the moment the rising was built around a salt guild and pulled in a mass of hungry people.
